auditMetadata.systemName: Sentinal Digital Operations Hub & CTF Wars Platform

findings.title: Public Registration Role Assignment and Tampering
findings.verificationEvidence: Negative testing across 5 payloads in scratch/test_sec001_complete.js confirmed server rejects FACULTY_COORDINATOR, DEVELOPMENT_TEAM, STUDENT_COORDINATOR, and extra parameters, unconditionally assigning role: GUEST and isApproved: false.

findings.title: Hierarchical RBAC Role Delegation Enforcement
findings.verificationEvidence: 7/7 vectors passed in scratch/run_sec002_fixed.js. STUDENT_COORDINATOR blocked (HTTP 403), FACULTY_COORDINATOR blocked from self-modification (HTTP 400) and promoting to peer/superior (HTTP 403), while permitted subordinate promotions succeeded (HTTP 200).

findings.title: Notification BOLA / IDOR Cross-Tenant Access
findings.verificationEvidence: 4/4 vectors passed in scratch/run_sec003_fixed.js. Attacker B blocked from updating User A notification (HTTP 404). Database confirmed isRead remained false. Zero data leakage in list queries.

findings.title: Event Capacity Concurrency & Race Conditions
findings.verificationEvidence: 0 capacity violations observed across 5 race test runs in scratch/run_sec004_fixed.js. Database registration count never exceeded maxCapacity due to PostgreSQL SELECT FOR UPDATE row-level locking.
findings.residualRisk: Under heavy lock contention (10+ racers), Prisma interactive transaction default 5000ms timeout returns HTTP 500 (P2028) for queued waiters rather than clean HTTP 400.

findings.title: HMAC Request Integrity Shield & Replay Protection
findings.verificationEvidence: 13/13 vectors passed in scratch/run_sec005_full.js. Rejects missing headers (403), forged signatures (403), stale/future timestamps (403), replayed nonces (403), body tampering (403), query tampering (403), and enforces policy header.

findings.title: CTF Hint Economy, Point Deductions & Isolation
findings.verificationEvidence: 5/5 vectors passed in scratch/run_sec006_real.js. Paid hint content masked before purchase; 25 points deducted upon unlock; ctfAuditLog created; subsequent unlocks idempotent (0 points deducted); participant isolation strictly maintained.

findings.title: Redis Failure Resilience & Graceful Degraded Mode
findings.verificationEvidence: CTF backend boots cleanly with Redis offline without process termination. Socket.IO presence falls back to in-memory tracking, and /api/health responds HTTP 200 OK.
findings.residualRisk: In ctf-platform/server/src/lib/locks.ts, acquireLock directly invokes redis.set without checking redis.status, causing flag submissions to hang on connection retries when Redis is offline.

findings.title: Firewall In-Memory Blacklist Caching & Invalidation
findings.verificationEvidence: Set.has() in-memory lookup takes 0.099 microseconds vs 1188 ms Neon DB query (12,000,000x throughput boost). HTTP latency dropped from 1431 ms to 13.2 ms. Immediate cache synchronization upon blocking an IP.
findings.residualRisk: In server/src/routes/maintenance.ts, unblocking an IP deletes DB and Redis records but fails to delete the IP from the local in-memory Set, leaving unblocked clients denied until the 30s background TTL expires.

findings.title: CTF Flag Guess HTTP Status Code Compliance
findings.verificationEvidence: Incorrect flag submission returns HTTP 200 with { result: 'INCORRECT' } in scratch/run_api001_flag.js. HTTP 429 is strictly reserved for rate limit threshold exhaustion after 10 requests/min.

findings.title: Accessible Names on Interactive Icon Buttons
findings.verificationEvidence: Headless Chromium inspection verified mobile navigation toggle has aria-label='Toggle Navigation Menu', password toggles have accessible names, and CTF sidebar icons have text descriptors.

findings.title: Heading Hierarchy Level Progression on Landing Page
findings.verificationEvidence: DOM heading tree evaluation confirmed sequential progression: H1 -> H2 -> H3 ('OFFENSIVE WARFARE', '7-TIER FORMATION') -> H4 ('[// DIRECTORY]'). Zero skipped levels found.

findings.title: Unicode Emoji Literals in Source Code
findings.verificationEvidence: Automated regex scan across 173 source files in client, server, and ctf-platform detected exactly 0 Unicode emoji characters. Lucide SVG components used exclusively.

findings.title: Horizontal Viewport Overflow on Mobile Displays Below 345px
findings.verificationEvidence: Empirical testing across all 12 target viewports (320x568 through 2560x1440) confirmed scrollWidth <= innerWidth in 100% of cases. Bounding width at 320px measured exactly 309px (zero overflow).

findings.title: Development JIT Compilation Latency Spikes
findings.verificationEvidence: Cold hits take 650ms-940ms under Next.js development server. Warm route transitions execute in ~20ms.
findings.residualRisk: Resolved naturally in production via pre-rendered static assets and server components (next build).

findings.title: Memory Footprint Across Dual Next.js Instances
findings.verificationEvidence: Dual development servers consume ~3.44 GB commit charge due to SWC/Turbopack memory caches.
findings.residualRisk: Resolved in production by deploying compiled standalone Node.js bundles (< 600 MB memory footprint).
